fact: Huawei's case study says NOSi's national data center hosts the eGovernment cloud, on which NOSi developed more than 150 websites and 77 eGovernment applications for all government departments, schools, hospitals and state-owned enterprises; capacity was raised to 1,000 VMs and 1,000 TB in phase two. Dated to the page's inferred publication date, 2018-07-05.

The document states the new State Data Center is the nerve centre of all Government communication, of the e-governance platform and of all public administration services, storing and processing their data; it is run by NOSI. Event date taken from the publication date, 29 July 2015.
